prompt: Orders can over-book stock in the shop/ package. After Inventory.reserve_many(), available() still reports those units as free, and an order with two lines for the same SKU can reserve more than is in stock. Fix it. reserve_many must stay all-or-nothing (if any line can't be reserved, raise OutOfStock and reserve nothing). SKUs are case- and whitespace-insensitive everywhere (" widget " and "WIDGET" are the same SKU).
